Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog
public class IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
IOB snapshot written when a BLE, pump-UI or Control-IQ bolus is initiated, before the bolus is delivered; IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog is its counterpart at completion.

Both IOB models the pump tracks are recorded, whichever one it displays. On pumps that answered ControlIQIOBRequest within 90 s of the record, getMudaliarIob() equalled mudaliarIOB and getSwan6hrIob() equalled swan6hrIOB, to the milliunit. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 206, so this class name is provisional. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/143.

      public int getUnknownU8At12()
      Returns:
      byte 12. Meaning unknown: 1 on every Control-IQ-off pump observed, 3 on most records from pumps running Control-IQ, and occasionally 2 or 0.

    • getMudaliarIob

      public float getMudaliarIob()
      Returns:
      IOB in units under the pump's Mudaliar model, whose decay follows the profile's insulin duration. When getSelectedIob() is 0 this is the IOB shown on the pump.

    • getSwan6hrIob

      public float getSwan6hrIob()
      Returns:
      IOB in units under the pump's Swan 6-hour model (ControlIQIOBResponse.swan6hrIOB). When getSelectedIob() is 1 this is the IOB shown on the pump.

    • getUnknownFloatAt22

      public float getUnknownFloatAt22()
      Returns:
      a third IOB-like value in units, of unidentified model. It is usually below getSwan6hrIob() and decays faster. Like the Swan value, and unlike the Mudaliar one, it usually rises by exactly the delivered amount between the pre- and post-bolus snapshots of one bolus.
